svg.text: The scenario's data space (v1.0.0-rc.1): Digital Lux Trust, the HDAB's own issuer, and two participants, each a portitor-connector and its portitor-identity, in one Compose project
(scenarios/data-permits/compose.yaml). The HDAB runs no connector: it only grants permits. Plain HTTP inside one container network; management APIs on 127.0.0.1 only.
One machine [Docker, or rootless Podman, with Docker Compose]
HDAB (health data access body: grants permits)
Lux Biobank (data holder; modelled on IBBL, LIH)
offers the genotypes: one offer per permit,
Schuman Clinical Research (data user; modelled on HRS)
holds the permits; takes the genotypes
fetches the genotypes with the transfer's
